subject.title: [Feature]: Add Ralph Loop feature and add max iteration number into the agent configuration

question: Should OpenClaw add a proactive STOP-driven repeated-prompt run mode in core, distinct from the iteration-budget safety circuit breaker?
rationale: This request adds a new execution mode and public configuration contract whose ownership, unlimited behavior, stop signal, and interaction with safety budgets cannot be selected safely from existing code alone.

options.title: Add bounded core mode
options.body: Implement a bounded per-agent repeated-run mode on the existing harness with explicit interruption and terminal-state behavior.

options.title: Expose plugin hook
options.body: Keep core policy unchanged and add only the runtime hook needed for a plugin to own repeated-run behavior.

options.title: Decline Ralph mode
options.body: Adopt only defensive iteration budgets and keep proactive repeated-prompt orchestration outside OpenClaw.

recommendation.title: Add bounded core mode
recommendation.body: Implement a bounded per-agent repeated-run mode on the existing harness with explicit interruption and terminal-state behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied issue discussion shows prior maintainer-side review of this exact product distinction and the need for an explicit direction.
